svg.text: NGINX is purpose built; redirect by URI path or
resource (Fig 3-9, the Invoice resource) is easy,
by request body parameter is harder; avoid hand-coded
proxies (slow); Lua can add custom behaviour to NGINX
slice smaller: move only part of Payroll, divert
matching calls; shared data would need a shared
database; use a feature toggle, canary or parallel
run; fold the work into normal feature delivery
Data is not covered yet: if the new Payroll service needs data in the monolith's database, see Chapter 4.
Always insert the proxy first and test redirection before you need it, so it is not a nasty surprise before going live.
